use: Club news and team-status briefing page panorama
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production-ready panoramic hero artwork for a football club management game's combined Club News and Team Briefing page.
Primary request: a football club briefing room that brings together the current team's situation and the club's latest news in a single cohesive environmental illustration.
Scene and shared composition: one continuous 3:1 wide panorama of a modest European football club's operations room, seen at eye level with a slightly elevated view of a broad wooden briefing table across the foreground. On the table: an open cream team report folder with small abstract football diagrams and simple charts, a tidy second set of team reports, a folded club newspaper, a pencil and a desk lamp. Behind the table: a large dark-green tactics board with a simple football pitch, small squad markers and restrained routes; next to it, a cork news board with a few pinned cream notices and football photo clippings. A generous window shows the club's green pitch and low stadium terraces. Modest shelving, green visitor chairs and a small plant finish the room. The focus is the owner's daily team-status and club-news briefing. Keep board, notices, report table and pitch window clearly visible in the central horizontal band, suitable for a shallow page header.
Constraints: illustration only, no UI mockup, no buttons, no interface panels, no page title, no decorative frame or border. No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no invented logos, no watermark. Papers and notices contain only abstract graphic marks. No people in the room. All actual game facts, titles and news will be live HTML outside the artwork. Edge-to-edge landscape scene, not a cutout object.
Theme: STICKER FOOTBALL CLUB, a cheerful light theme with smooth matte surfaces, friendly rounded forms, sunny-yellow accents and green football details.
Style and medium: polished colourful 2D football storybook / sports-comic illustration, tidy confident contours, softened rounded furniture, crisp clean cel shading, subtle smooth matte tactile materials. Warm oat and vanilla walls, honey-coloured wood, soft cream paper, deep green chairs and tactics board, sunny yellow accents. Brighter and friendlier than the naturalistic Stadium Green theme, with charming slightly simplified shapes but still a believable complete room. No paper grain, no distressed printing, no halftone, no pixel art, no photorealism, no chunky toy diorama, no sticker-sheet cutout border.
Lighting and mood: clear sunny afternoon through a window onto a vividly green small football pitch, soft clean shadows, upbeat and calm, inviting for a daily team briefing. Harmonize with existing bright clean sports-comic football-club interiors.
Deliver only the finished wide 3:1 illustration.
